notices.title: Legacy depeg risk
notices.message: USDX is trading at roughly a 45% discount to its dollar peg, sustained by legacy debt positions on Kava Mint CDPs. Pharos tracks the active provider entry separately from the historical cemetery incident.

mintAuthority.summary: USDX is minted by Kava Mint's x/cdp module: users lock crypto collateral and draw USDX up to a governance-set debt limit, with Kava (KAVA) on-chain governance and a Stability Committee controlling the global debt limit, accepted collateral, ratios, and fees.

controls.label: Kava x/cdp module (USDX mint)
controls.capDescription: Mint bounded by per-collateral and global USDX debt limits and collateral ratios enforced by the Kava x/cdp module.
controls.evidence: At Kava height 21133461, the x/cdp params API returned debt denom usdx, debt floor 10000000, and 10 live collateral parameter sets with per-collateral debt limits and liquidation ratios. The x/cdp module mints USDX only through overcollateralized CDPs under those parameters.

controls.label: Kava on-chain governance + Stability Committee (KAVA)
controls.evidence: At Kava height 21133461, committee id 1 resolved as the Kava Stability Committee with five members, vote_threshold 0.5, proposal_duration 604800s, and permissions covering cdp GlobalDebtLimit, CollateralParams, and DebtParam changes.

review.evidence: Kava Network documentation describes USDX as minted by the x/cdp module against overcollateralized positions. Phase 0c second pass confirmed live x/cdp params and Stability Committee membership/threshold on Kava at height 21133461.
